quotes.text: When someone needs help, they want to talk to a real person, not an AI algorithm. I support using new technologies to improve services at Social Security, but we can't forget about the people. We need to invest in customer service & enhance Social Security benefits, not cut them! https://t.co/uqKeCNJQ41

I met with @AFGENational Council 220 as we continue to work together to defend the dignity of work. Americans deserve assistance from real workers - not some AI algorithm - when they need help from their government. We’ll never stop fighting to protect YOUR hard-earned benefits! https://t.co/Hj0g1JGySL

While the rise of artificial intelligence offers the promise of innovation and advancement, we can’t sit idly by and allow workers to be left behind. [...] We can’t let big tech moguls make billions on this disruptive technology without investing our workforce. The Congress urgently needs to act to pass nationwide AI regulations and standards that preserve jobs, protect children, and advance global technological competitiveness. AI technology should work for us, not the other way around and this bill takes an important step in that direction.

The federal government wants to use AI to examine your TAX DATA. 
 
@RepGwenMoore, @RepDelBene, and I are demanding answers from the IRS on how they plan to use AI to review your sensitive tax records. We won't let your personal information get handed over to Big Tech. https://t.co/jTai8sm1lM

While Trump tries to block states from regulating artificial intelligence, Connecticut is leading the nation to make sure AI works for us, not Big Tech billionaires. Proud to stand with @GovNedLamont and state leaders to sign a law putting guardrails on AI and supporting workers. https://t.co/AOGYJ6ipsq

When ‘DOGE’ tried to close the Torrington Social Security office, we fought back and stopped them.
 
The Trump Administration is still taking an axe to the Social Security Administration. They want to replace workers with AI chatbots and privatize the agency. Not on our watch! https://t.co/sf7eXSTRzG

AI isn’t slowing down and neither should Congress, but Republicans are trying to walk off the job.   I joined my Democratic colleagues to call on Speaker Johnson to keep Congress in town.   There is no time to wait. We need to pass real safeguards on the use of AI NOW! https://t.co/HH3l4dj2ZC
